findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in list map
findings.body: The previous GrafanaRuleLoader was rendered with key={key}, but the replacement GrafanaRuleListItem in the rules.map has no key. React will warn about missing keys and may reuse or remount items incorrectly as pages load or the list changes. Add key={key}.

findings.title: Silence drawer never renders in the list view
findings.body: The SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer is only shown when a rulerRule is present (rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)). The list view now passes only promRule, so rule is undefined. The Silence menu item is shown through the prom ability, but clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer and nothing renders, so the action does nothing.

findings.title: Delete menu item hidden when only promRule is available
findings.body: The delete item requires `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the list view rulerRule is undefined, so the Delete action is never shown even though the grafana prom ability grants it. Also handleDelete takes a RulerRuleDTO, so deletion from the list is effectively lost. This is a functional regression, and the RulesTable delete tests only pass because they use ruler rules.

findings.title: returnTo dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The old loader built the href with createReturnTo() so the view page could navigate back to the list. The new href omits returnTo, so users lose the back-navigation context.
